title: Famous bands and advertising trucks and band contests
summary: Oliver and Jack Carey bands were famous; bands on advertising trucks were challenged to out-play each other.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Ori had a good band and Jack Carey. Oh yes. Well them was famous bands, Jack Carey, and that's the time we was advertising then. On trucks for, for, for, for dancers, you see. Did your band play on those trucks at the L2, to advertise? Oh man, sure. T.L. gate, man, you hang, back up, like that call backing up there and tie up there in the stadium and play yourself crazy. What they was doing that for, I don't know. Man, every time they see a band, they'll catch them. Make them play. Stop them and buck them. To see who could play, who, play the longest. I grabbed a little punch one day. I played some of Louis' numbers. dear
